section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measures used in a study conducted in Indonesia. Participants completed the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item measure translated into Indonesian using back-translation techniques. Demographics were collected including sex, age, ethnicity, height, and weight, with height and weight used to calculate BMI.
